name: Konstantin Ryzhov
description: Senior Full-Stack Product Engineer (TypeScript, React, Node.js) with 12+ years building web products. dRPC's first engineering hire and largest web app contributor over 4 years. Owned features end to end across authentication, payments, teams and analytics, from data model to UI. Recent AI work: a RAG docs assistant and x402 payments for AI agents. Based in Almaty, Kazakhstan; working remotely since 2019.

experiences.title: Senior Full-Stack Developer
achievements: First engineering hire, working alongside the CTO and CEO, and the largest contributor to the customer web application over 4 years. dRPC is blockchain RPC infrastructure (drpc.org); its core RPC service handled ~120B requests a month across all chains in 2026.

Built and launched the customer-facing web application for dRPC's core RPC service from scratch. Selected the web stack (TypeScript, React, Next.js, tRPC and PostgreSQL/Prisma) and delivered account access, API-key management, payments and usage analytics.

Implemented wallet authentication and crypto top-ups using wagmi and Sign-In with Ethereum with one-time signing challenges. Embedded payment identifiers in ERC-20 transaction calldata so the billing backend could attribute transfers to the correct account.

Built the email notification worker on RabbitMQ: a standalone Node.js consumer that turns balance, tier, team and add-on events from the Go RPC proxy into customer emails, with its own queues, a fan-out exchange for team members, prefetch-based backpressure and message deduplication.

Enabled shared access to accounts and balances by introducing team workspaces, role-aware interfaces and backend authorization through tRPC middleware. Migrated existing users to personal teams with zero downtime, preserving working API keys without requiring customer action.

Added email/password and Google sign-in alongside wallet login, hardened authentication with brute-force protection, constant-time comparison, audit logging and tenant-scoped authorization fixes, with Vitest tests.

Rebuilt customer usage analytics with shared filters, drill-down tables and CSV export over 10+ ClickHouse-backed endpoints. Fixed out-of-memory failures in ClickHouse queries and added server-side caching for expensive aggregates on the largest accounts.
Expanded a crypto-only payment flow with Paddle card payments and recurring billing, enabling one-time top-ups and automatic monthly replenishment of team balances.

Upgraded wagmi and viem from v1 to v2 on the live payment flow and shipped the public faucet with 2 anti-sybil checks, browser proof-of-work and Gitcoin Passport scoring; built the Gitcoin Passport claim path in the faucet backend.

Built the Foundation analytics dashboard end to end, including the UI, API and ClickHouse queries, giving blockchain foundations visibility into the geographic distribution of requests to their nodes on dRPC.

Built the x402 payment endpoint that lets AI agents pay for RPC access without a human account: HTTP 402 payment requirements, wallet-signature verification and hand-off to the billing backend for on-chain settlement. Audited the implementation against the x402 v2 specification.
Automated post-paid enterprise invoicing with an admin review-and-send console, server-side PDF rendering and email delivery to configurable recipients, replacing a manual process.
Designed the public Key-Management REST API with bearer authentication, typed domain errors and an OpenAPI specification, so customers can manage API keys and tags programmatically.

Prototyped a RAG docs assistant for dRPC's developer hub that answers from the docs with citations: OpenAI Agents SDK and PostgreSQL/pgvector, SSE streaming, multi-turn query rewriting, layered guardrails and an eval harness that decided which retrieval changes shipped.
